# 此刻 · The Present — Julia Yuen

> Hong Kong information-field consultancy and small-batch handmade studio.
> TimeWaver information-field consultations (remote), personalised natural essential-oil perfume,
> handmade natural lip balm, and DIY lip balm workshops.
> Site: https://juliayuen.com/ · Languages: 繁體中文 / 简体中文 / English

**Important:** TimeWaver is not a medical device. Nothing offered here diagnoses, treats,
or replaces medical or professional care.

## Who

Julia Yuen (袁小姐) — certified TimeWaver Pro consultant, registered teacher with 20 years'
experience, Brain Gym consultant trainer, mother of two. Based in Hong Kong (Causeway Bay);
consultations are delivered remotely worldwide. Works in Cantonese, Mandarin and English.

## Services and prices (HKD, updated 2026-09)

### TimeWaver 資訊場諮詢 — information-field consultation (remote)
- First session: **HK$1,280** — 30-minute Zoom/phone consultation + written report + **2 weeks of field balancing** + review report
- Continuing without a break: **HK$980** per session (2 weeks)
- 3 months / 6 sessions booked together: **HK$4,980** (HK$830 per session)
- Typical commitment: 1–3 months, or a few sessions a year
- Families running sessions at the same time receive a complimentary family-relationship session
- Details: https://juliayuen.com/faq.html#tw

### 此刻 · 香頻 Scent of Now — personalised natural essential-oil perfume
- 對頻 **HK$980** — finding the scent that fits you now
- 調和 **HK$1,980** — tuned perfume; the frequency is carried in the bottle
- 顯化 **HK$3,800** — tuned perfume + 30 days of personal remote frequency balancing
- Fully remote; ships 7–10 working days after the blend is confirmed
- Details: https://juliayuen.com/perfume/

### 此刻 · 唇語 Balm of Now — handmade natural lip balm
- 1–10 pcs **HK$78** each · 11–30 **HK$75** · 31–50 **HK$70** · 51–100 **HK$65** · 100+ quote on request
- Minimum order 2 pieces; scent can be chosen from 20 pieces up
- Lead time 10–14 working days; same-day pickup if in stock
- Four ingredient groups, all disclosed: shea butter, beeswax, plant oils, pure essential oils
- Shelf life 12 months; use within 6 months of opening
- Contains sesame oil. Mint formula not recommended under age 6. Patch-test before first use.
- Details: https://juliayuen.com/lip/

### DIY 手作潤唇膏班 — DIY lip balm workshop
- **HK$280** per person, minimum 2 people, **60 minutes** per session, up to 12 people
- Parent-and-child, company training, corporate events, birthday parties, or custom
- Causeway Bay, Hong Kong; private groups can be hosted at your own venue
- Details: https://juliayuen.com/lip/#class
